output.title: Contemporary 3-Bedroom Apartment with Panoramic Kirchberg Park Views
output.description:
Situated in the prestigious Kirchberg district, this exquisite 145 m² three-bedroom apartment epitomizes modern urban living within Luxembourg's renowned EU quarter. Crafted as a new-build residence, the home showcases a double-height ceiling in the expansive living area, complemented by south-facing engineered wood floors that infuse the space with abundant natural light. Seamlessly integrating the dining and lounge zones, the open-plan layout invites relaxed entertaining and sophisticated daily living.

The minimalist kitchen is equipped with premium Bulthaup cabinetry and a central island featuring an induction cooktop set into elegant stone worktops. This culinary space balances form and function, designed to cater to discerning tastes while offering a stylish breakfast bar perfect for casual dining. Floor-to-ceiling windows open onto a private balcony with a sleek glass balustrade, providing tranquil views over Kirchberg park — an ideal setting to enjoy morning coffee or unwind in serene surroundings.

Two meticulously appointed bathrooms elevate comfort and luxury, highlighted by a spa-inspired ensuite with a walk-in rain shower, double vanity, and underfloor heating, framed by refined porcelain tiles. Additional amenities include an elevator for ease of access, secure parking, and dedicated storage, underscoring convenience alongside elegance.

Located amidst landmarks such as the Philharmonie and MUDAM, and close to reputable international schools, this apartment offers exceptional appeal to expatriates and professionals seeking a sophisticated lifestyle combined with proximity to Luxembourg’s vibrant business and cultural hubs. With modern architecture seamlessly blending with practical design, this residence embodies the essence of Kirchberg’s dynamic yet refined character.

highlights.text: Spacious living room with double-height ceilings and south-facing windows
Gourmet kitchen featuring Bulthaup cabinetry and central island
Private balcony overlooking tranquil Kirchberg park
Spa-like ensuite bathroom with walk-in rain shower and underfloor heating
Secure parking space and dedicated storage included
Convenient elevator access within a prestigious new-build complex
Prime location in the EU quarter near Philharmonie and international schools
